boards.school_name: South Dakota School of Mines and Technology
boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named campus spaces with documented student-facing uses, from peer support and student government to research, organizations, and essentials.

cards.title: Devereaux Library
cards.subtitle: Library study spaces and student-success hub
cards.notes: Use the library as a practical reset between classes: locate a study seat, then connect with the Vanderboom Office of Student Success if you need academic support.
cards.short_summary: A renovated library combining study space, collections, archives, and student-success services.
cards.evidence_claim: South Dakota Mines identifies Devereaux Library as home to student study spaces, the Vanderboom Office of Student Success, a makerspace, collections, and archives.
cards.source_title: South Dakota Mines Virtual Tour & Campus Highlights
cards.access_notes: Campus map lists Devereaux Library at 501 East Saint Joseph St.; check library access rules before visiting.

cards.title: Slide Rule Lounge
cards.subtitle: Devereaux Library tutoring location
cards.notes: Bring a specific problem and check in with a tutor during the posted schedule; tutors are stationed here and use a QR code for student check-in.
cards.short_summary: A named library lounge used as the in-person base for Student Success tutoring.
cards.evidence_claim: The Spring 2026 tutoring schedule states that all tutors in the Tutoring Center are stationed in the Slide Rule Lounge in Devereaux Library.
cards.access_notes: Consult the current tutoring schedule before going; tutoring sessions and subjects vary by day.

cards.title: Devereaux Library Makerspace
cards.subtitle: Inside Devereaux Library
cards.notes: Plan a project-focused stop: confirm available equipment or support, then use the makerspace alongside nearby library study and student-success resources.
cards.short_summary: A named making space embedded in the library’s student-support environment.
cards.evidence_claim: South Dakota Mines lists a makerspace among the facilities in Devereaux Library.
cards.source_title: South Dakota Mines Virtual Tour & Campus Highlights
cards.access_notes: Ask library or Student Success staff about current equipment access, training, and availability.

cards.title: Student Food Pantry
cards.subtitle: Surbeck Center, past Student Health Services
cards.notes: If you need food support, head down the hall from the Rocker Shop past Student Health Services and take what you need from this campus pantry.
cards.short_summary: A student food-support space in Surbeck Center with round-the-clock access.
cards.evidence_claim: South Dakota Mines says the Student Food Pantry is in Surbeck Center, down the hall from the Rocker Shop past Student Health Services, and is open 24/7.
cards.access_notes: The university lists the pantry as open 24/7; follow any posted pantry-use guidance on arrival.

cards.title: Ivanhoe International Center
cards.subtitle: Surbeck Student Center
cards.notes: Stop in when you need international-student support or want to explore education-abroad options; the center connects students with campus international activities.
cards.short_summary: A Surbeck-based center for international students and students pursuing education abroad.
cards.evidence_claim: South Dakota Mines states that the Ivanhoe International Center is located in the Surbeck Student Center and is the center of international activities on campus.
cards.access_notes: Contact the center for current advising and program availability.

cards.title: Student Association Senate Office
cards.subtitle: Surbeck Center, Room 142
cards.notes: Use the office as a starting point for student-government questions, or attend a listed committee meeting to observe how student organization and campus issues are handled.
cards.short_summary: The named Surbeck office used for Student Association Senate committee meetings.
cards.evidence_claim: South Dakota Mines lists the Student Association Senate Office in Surbeck Center Room 142 as the meeting location for several Senate committees.
cards.access_notes: The Senate page says everyone is welcome at its meetings; verify the current meeting schedule before attending.

cards.entity_name: Rich & Trudy Wells Veterans Resource Center
cards.title: Rich & Trudy Wells Veterans Resource Center
cards.subtitle: Lower level of Surbeck Center
cards.notes: Veteran and military-connected students can use this campus resource center to find support, connections, and referrals during the term.
cards.short_summary: A Surbeck-based resource center documented as a place of camaraderie and support for veteran students.
cards.evidence_claim: South Dakota Mines describes the Rich & Trudy Wells Veterans Resource Center in the lower part of Surbeck Center as a resource providing veteran students camaraderie and support.
cards.source_title: Mines Plans Upgrades to Veterans Resource Center Thanks to Alumni Donors
cards.access_notes: Intended for veteran students; contact the university for current access and services.

cards.title: Museum of Geology
cards.subtitle: O’Harra Building
cards.notes: Set aside time to view the geology and paleontology collections, then look for the museum’s online exhibits featuring Mines faculty and student research.
cards.short_summary: A campus museum where students, faculty, and visitors engage with geological and paleontological objects.
cards.evidence_claim: South Dakota Mines says the Museum of Geology continues as a space of learning and research for students, faculty, and visitors.
cards.source_title: Museum of Geology at South Dakota Mines Celebrates 100 Years
cards.access_notes: The museum’s current visitor page lists paid admission for most visitors; review current admission details before visiting.

cards.entity_name: James E. Martin Paleontology Research Lab
cards.title: James E. Martin Paleontology Research Lab
cards.subtitle: Map-listed campus paleontology destination
cards.notes: For geology or paleontology interests, ask your department about lab-linked learning and research opportunities rather than assuming walk-in public access.
cards.short_summary: A named research-lab destination connected to the geology department’s hands-on learning environment.
cards.evidence_claim: South Dakota Mines identifies the James E. Martin Paleontology Laboratory among affiliated facilities where geology and geological engineering students undertake hands-on learning.
cards.access_notes: The campus map lists the James E. Martin Paleontology Research Lab; research spaces may require department permission.

cards.title: Vanderboom Laboratory for Entrepreneurial Research
cards.subtitle: V-LAB on the South Dakota Mines campus
cards.notes: If you are developing an invention or project, use the V-LAB’s innovation programming as a reason to ask about current student opportunities and deadlines.
cards.short_summary: A named campus entrepreneurship destination tied to a student inventor award program.
cards.evidence_claim: South Dakota Mines lists the Vanderboom Laboratory for Entrepreneurial Research (V-LAB) in the Braun Student Inventor Award information for students.
cards.access_notes: The campus map lists the V-LAB; contact the Office of Economic Development for current programming and access.
